Economy | Representative Sarah Elfreth Skip to main content Economy Congresswoman Elfreth, a proud daughter of a union family, understands the needs of hardworking families and the transformational power of a good job. She has fought to reduce the barriers that prevent families from achieving economic opportunity, including bringing down the cost of child care and reducing the burden of student loans. Maryland’s Third District is home to scientific innovation and research in aerospace, renewable energy, and cybersecurity, leading our nation’s economy into the future. The Congresswoman is proud to support this innovation while putting families first through her focus on job security and support for local businesses. Education | Representative Sarah Elfreth Skip to main content Education Congresswoman Elfreth is a graduate of the public school system and a scholarship recipient to Maryland’s own Towson University. The Congresswoman was a student member of the University System of Maryland’s Board of Regents and then went on to teach a public policy course at Towson University. Her experiences as both a student and an educator have informed her approach to strengthening our educational system and supporting our students and faculty. She is committed to working toward accessible and affordable education for all—building a bright future for all Maryland students.    Issues Economy Environment Education Federal Workers Gun Violence Prevention Health Care National Security & Veterans Reproductive Freedoms What I’m Doing to Fight the Abuses of the Trump Administration Back to top button

Environment | Representative Sarah Elfreth Skip to main content Environment Maryland’s Third District is home to the beautiful Chesapeake Bay, a crucial wildlife habitat and economic resource that the Congresswoman is dedicated to protecting and preserving. As the Vice Ranking Member of the Natural Resources Committee, Congresswoman Elfreth is determined to combat the climate crisis by leading meaningful action in environmental restoration and protection and moving America toward a clean energy economy. Elfreth opened by highlighting cuts to the federal workforce and funding at the National Park Service (NPS) by the Trump Administration. Reproductive Freedoms | Representative Sarah Elfreth Skip to main content Reproductive Freedoms The fight for women’s rights and reproductive freedom has spanned generations, and in a post-Roe America, keeping up the fight is more important than ever. Congresswoman Elfreth is a proud advocate for women’s reproductive freedom. She believes strongly in safeguarding women’s ability to receive life-saving care and protecting access to abortion care, IVF, and birth control. In Congress, she is determined to fight to make Roe v. Wade the law of the land. What I’m Doing to Fight the Abuses of the Trump Administration | Representative Sarah Elfreth Skip to main content What I’m Doing to Fight the Abuses of the Trump Administration Since the inauguration, the Trump Administration has taken numerous unlawful and reckless actions, hurting countless communities. Constituents call my office daily expressing fear and outrage about how President Trump and his appointees are harming the integrity of the federal government and the country.  I share their anger and concern, and as your Congresswoman, I am fighting back against the Trump Administration's attempts to undermine the Constitution and the American people at every opportunity. Here are some efforts I am taking to stop the Administration from harming my constituents, our communities, and the country: Listening To You, And Supporting Constituents on the Ground For my first year in Congress, building strong relationships with my constituents and local leaders has been a priority to provide the best support for you. In my first year in office, I hosted 20 town halls , both in person and online , to meet with you directly and hear about the top issues facing my constituents daily. My team and I also answered 11,854 calls and 36,383 emails from our neighbors across the Third District, all of which has helped inform my work in Washington over the past year.  Image Elfreth hears constituent concerns at Ellicott City Town Hall. Since then, I have criss-crossed the Third District, hearing from folks at  service academy forums and  childcare roundtables ; meeting with a range of local leaders from  Major Generals and  Lieutenant Colonels to Presidents across the University System of Maryland; and visiting  community associations ,  Maryland hospitals facing cuts, and numerous nonprofits serving our community to better understand how our Maryland communities have directly been impacted by this Administration.  I am hearing your calls, stories, and concerns firsthand and sharing information wherever I can to provide guidance and support during these unprecedented times.
